name: JW Marriott Hotel Lima
positioning: Ocean-view luxury hotel in Lima's Miraflores district, within steps of the beach and the Costa Verde and right across from the Larcomar shopping center
best_for: Travelers who want ocean views from every room in Miraflores
First-time visitors to Lima who want a central coastal base

facts.text: The hotel is situated within steps of the beach and the Costa Verde.
The hotel sits right across from the seaside Larcomar shopping center.
Conde Nast Traveler notes much of the hotel has sweeping ocean views and is within walking distance of notable restaurants and sites.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the vibe as traditional luxury with a high-gloss exterior and crisp, clean, modern rooms.
The Executive Lounge offers panoramic city views.
The Health Club has a full range of equipment and ocean views.
The hotel has a spa for unwinding after a day in Miraflores.
The hotel offers Zumba and Spinning classes.
JW Lounge serves Nikkei cuisine with a sushi bar, ceviche and signature cocktails.
Miraflores offers culinary options, bars, shopping and local beaches.
The hotel holds Green Key certification for sustainability.

highlights.text: All of the hotel's rooms and suites feature ocean views.
The executive rooms are on the hotel's highest floors and take in expansive Pacific Ocean views.
The Executive Suites have ocean views and a whirlpool.
La Vista Restaurant has Pacific Ocean views and modern cuisine from a team of Peruvian chefs.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes an urban hotel setting in a busy district.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: JW Marriott Hotel Lima
